fields.name: Discount
fields.description: Discount rate applied to the order line

calculations.name: Profit Status
calculations.tableau: IF [Profit] > 0 THEN 'Profitable' ELSEIF [Profit] = 0 THEN 'Break-even' ELSE 'Loss' END

calculations.name: Discount Band
warnings: Calculated column uses parameter 'Discount Threshold': it is evaluated at refresh with the default value. Use a measure for interactive behaviour.

calculations.name: Customer Lifetime Sales
calculations.pbi_dax: (VAR __lod1 = RELATED('Customers'[Customer Name]) RETURN CALCULATE(SUM('Orders'[Sales]), REMOVEFILTERS(), 'Customers'[Customer Name] = __lod1))

calculations.name: Running Sales
calculations.pbi_dax: CALCULATE(SUM('Orders'[Sales]), WINDOW(1, ABS, 0, REL, ALLSELECTED('Orders'[Order Date Quarter Start]), ORDERBY('Orders'[Order Date Quarter Start])))

calculations.name: Avg Sales per Customer
warnings: Aggregation over 'Customers' is filtered through 'Orders' so that filters on other dimensions apply (Tableau relationship semantics).

calculations.name: Selected Metric
calculations.tableau: CASE [Parameters].[Parameter 4] WHEN 'Sales' THEN SUM([Sales]) WHEN 'Profit' THEN SUM([Profit]) ELSE SUM([Quantity]) END
calculations.pbi_dax: SWITCH([Metric Selector Value], "Sales", SUM('Orders'[Sales]), "Profit", SUM('Orders'[Profit]), SUM('Orders'[Quantity]))

calculations.name: Customer Tier
calculations.tableau: IF [Customer Lifetime Sales] >= 25000 THEN 'Platinum' ELSEIF [Customer Lifetime Sales] >= 12000 THEN 'Gold' ELSE 'Silver' END

calculations.name: Order Month Name
warnings: DATENAME() output depends on the model culture (FORMAT locale).

calculations.name: Percent of Total Sales
warnings: TOTAL() uses ALLSELECTED: matches Tableau grand-total for additive measures.

calculations.name: Top 20 Customers
warnings: Top-N set evaluated at refresh (static); ranks rows of 'Customers' (one row per [Customer Name] assumed).
